known_unparsed.txt - PostgreSQL 17 regression statements that parse.Parse still rejects.

Generated with tests/parsecheck:
  tin build tests/parsecheck/main.tin -o bin/parsecheck
  bin/parsecheck /path/to/tingres-pgsrc/pg/src/test/regress/sql/*.sql

As of the last run: TOTAL 227 files, 115 fully parsed, 45399 of 46240 statements
parsed (98.18%). The 841 remaining statements fall into the categories below;
count is the number of failing statements in that category. Many are intentionally
invalid statements that the regression suite uses to test PostgreSQL's own error
reporting (for example 'SELECT * FROM a_star*' in inheritance.sql or the syntax-error
section of constraints.sql), and psql/encoding artefacts (euc_kr.sql). The rest are
grammar not modelled yet, listed with a one-line reason.
